findings.acceptance: From both pages at both viewports, open the approved checklist and verify its content, not just an HTTP 200.
findings.impact: The practice scope requires this preparation download without an accepted alternative. Two pages are affected by one unique unavailable URL.
findings.observation: At 1440x900 and 390x844, following the checklist link from home and resources opened the approved text on source and the same 404 URL on target. HTTP capture and byte checks agree.
findings.recommendation: Publish the approved sample checklist at /downloads/checklist.txt or update both entry points to an approved destination.
findings.title: Required checklist download returns 404

findings.acceptance: At desktop and mobile sizes, verify the H1, exact approved guidance and order; retain the kit and download link.
findings.impact: Learners lose preparation instructions and the main page heading; heading structure also regresses.
findings.observation: The source resources page displays Learning resources as H1 and the preparation paragraph. The target starts with Your preparation kit (H2) and omits both source elements at both viewports.
findings.recommendation: Restore the approved H1 and introductory preparation paragraph before the kit.
findings.title: Resources heading and preparation guidance omitted

findings.acceptance: At 390x844 and 1440x900, all panel copy fits without horizontal scrolling and remains matched to source.
findings.impact: Mobile learners cannot read the panel naturally without horizontal scrolling. Matching static text does not establish responsive parity.
findings.observation: At 390x844, target .contact-panel is 760 CSS pixels wide and the document spans 780 pixels, clipping text and requiring horizontal scrolling. Source panel is 335 pixels wide and fits. Desktop content matches.
findings.recommendation: Remove the target-only fixed mobile width and allow the panel to fit its container.
findings.title: Contact panel overflows the mobile viewport
